standard_prerequisites: vanishing of higher cohomology of quasi-coherent sheaves on affines (Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma coherent-lemma-quasi-coherent-affine-cohomology-zero) via the higher direct image discussion of Cohomology of Spaces
surjectivity of H^0 on affines for surjective maps of quasi-coherent sheaves

the derived limit criterion for systems of sheaves with surjective transitions and vanishing higher cohomology on a basis (Cohomology on Sites, Lemma sites-cohomology-lemma-derived-limit-suitable-system)
the identification of ordinary and derived limits under these conditions (Cohomology on Sites, Lemma sites-cohomology-lemma-inverse-limit-is-derived-limit)
core_obligations: Prove for an inverse system (K_n) in D_QCoh(O_X) with surjective transitions on cohomology sheaves and derived limit K: (1) H^q(K) = lim H^q(K_n); (2) Rlim H^q(K_n) = lim H^q(K_n); (3) H^p(U, lim H^q(K_n)) = 0 for p > 0 and U affine open
proof_roadmap: On the basis of affine objects the sheaves H^q(K_n) have no higher cohomology and the induced maps on H^0 are surjective, which are precisely the conditions of the derived-limit criterion.
Part (1) follows by applying the criterion to the system of complexes.
Parts (2) and (3) follow from the identification of the ordinary limit with the derived limit under these conditions.
difficulty_reason: H2: a criterion-checking lemma where the work is verifying vanishing and surjectivity on the affine basis.
